dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh search results were analytical, humanitarian or follow-on coverage and did not establish a distinct same-day SAF-RSF offensive, new chemical deployment or Red Sea spillover. The already-extreme lane holds at 90%

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP satellite analysis says Israel has built more than 23 kilometres of earthen barrier in recent months and confirms rapid July extensions, while later reporting details five Palestinians killed in Monday strikes. The construction is cumulative rather than a same-hour deployment, and the kinetic reports overlap events already reviewed; the near-ceiling lane holds at 88%

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh confirmed Abyei or Uganda-South Sudan border attack surfaced. Current risk still rests on the previously corroborated Kajo-Keji skirmish, reinforcement and displacement evidence

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: OCHA’s humanitarian brief plus current searches produced analytical and press-freedom items but no distinct same-day FARDC-M23 or Rwanda-linked battlefield escalation, so the lane holds at 52%

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: AP quotes the Saudi military saying it will keep Bab el-Mandeb open and respond to threats, but the Houthi embargo declaration still lacks an attributable post-declaration attack or interdiction. No Saudi strike or broad new rerouting threshold was verified, so risk holds at 46%

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters syndication and follow-on reports continue to corroborate heavy Anefis-Gao convoy losses, but no new strategic seizure, separate mass-casualty event or regional-force intervention appeared after the already-scored attack cycle

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Post-scan Al Jazeera and Japan Times reports add corroboration but describe the same Second Thomas Shoal clash and U.S. reaction already scored. No firearm use, death, vessel seizure, new deployment or treaty consultation surfaced; raw risk holds at 21%

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Additional maritime outlets corroborate the Asana tanker hijack and diversion toward Somali waters, but they describe the same qualifying event rather than another attack. No rescue outcome, crew harm, ransom demand or new interdiction surfaced; the lane holds at 28%
